title: Ride Comfort, Seats, and Isolated Fit Issues
summary: Feedback in this topic spans praised ride comfort, acceleration, and seat feel alongside isolated reports about windshield quality and a loose roof panel, with many fragments remaining descriptive rather than clearly evaluative.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise smooth ride comfort, strong acceleration, dreamlike driving, and comfortable or plush seats.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention dissatisfaction with windshield durability compared with BMW.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments describe vehicle speed, dark interior shades, a hard-to-learn interface, seat plushness, higher ride height, and a roof panel coming loose without enough clear sentiment labeling to summarize them as positive or negative.

limitations: Many fragments are labeled undetermined, which limits confidence in a clear sentiment read for several aspects.
This topic mixes comfort impressions, performance comments, interface learning, windshield quality, and a roof-panel incident rather than one tightly focused subject.
Examples are limited, so they are insufficient to assess how broadly any single issue applies beyond these sampled reports.
